status_by.quote: So this PR is mostly orthogonal to it: #24230 changes how indexes sync with the chain and removes index dependencies on node internals, while this PR moves index ownership into NodeContext.

claims.quote: Are the custom deleters really needed? NodeContext already handles this for its other unique_ptr members via the destructor here
